notes: AlvaAR remains the only camera-pose authority. The local/uploaded Depth Anything V2 ONNX model is explicitly tested before Scan, runs in an isolated ONNX Runtime Web worker at no more than 1 Hz, and its live relative depth map is shown over the camera. AI depth is calibrated into the current Alva world scale and accepted for surfel/TSDF/gaussian fusion only after Alva anchors and multi-view verification.
